### Forest {#review-app-2}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: Aug 3, 2026 - Sep 11, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _jokal3112_, Aug 11, 2026, 1/5: "Absolute worst customer service I've ever experienced. My bike was broken, so I couldn't end the ride — the timer just kept running. I then tried every way possible to reach support: emailed 5 times (no response), called twice (couldn't get through), tried live chat twice (it's frozen), and even the email address listed on the website is no longer a working address. Not a single contact channel actually works. On top of that, I regularly lose minutes from my 1,200-minute subscription to broken bikes, and reported bugs never get reimbursed. I had to buy an extra 500-minute bundle, which is now being drained by the exact same issue. The referral bonus I was promised for friends who signed up also never showed up. An app you can't actually reach anyone through when something goes wrong isn't usable. Can't recommend this right now."
            2. _HL46645_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "This is an objectively terrible app. It has constant issues that cannot be put into a review. It constantly lets you down and is significantly worse than competitors. This wouldn’t be an issue if it didn’t resort to buying monopolies in areas to force people into paying for its horrible service who have no other choice. It will constantly let you down and make you pay for the privilege. Awful"
            3. _Sarahharki_, Sep 9, 2026, 2/5: "Forest bikes are great - a bit heavy but a comfy ride. Good manoeuvrability. However, I generally always choose other electric bikes as Forest are very expensive, costing my double on a short journey than Voi or Lime. Also I have found the app to be very glitchy. hence the 2 stars"

### Forest: Focus for Productivity {#review-app-5}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      10 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 16, 2026 - Nov 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Keith Gold_, Nov 18, 2026, 1/5: "Why change something if it’s not broken, we all loved the old user interface Can you please add a search function in the choose a tag section before I start a session currently I have to manually search for a tag before a session which is really not ideal"
            2. _I_Adze_, Oct 18, 2026, 1/5: "Was a loyal user of Forest for 5 years, I paid for the app and loved it for 4 of those years The app took a new direction around a year ago, it moved from a one-time fee to a freemium model and this was the beginning of the slop The app moved from incredibly stable to receiving regular forced updates that introduced bugs. The team introduced more trees along with daily login events and timed events. This completely defeats the point of getting off your phone and focusing. When your focus app needs you to log in daily and rewards you with cosmetics, it is no longer a focus app, it’s part of the problem. Under the most recent update they removed the ability to configure “favourites” which were easy to pick combinations of tags and trees, completely gutting my use of the app and violating their promise of retaining pro features that users paid for. Do not trust this company, do not download this app. It will demand your attention and focus on your screen, it will not help you focus on other things. It’s a shame as it was a great app for many years. They should’ve left the app as it was and paid for the marketing of a new app, but instead they chose to predate their own user base in lieu of taking the risk of launching a new app."
            3. _Rachel C_, Sep 27, 2026, 1/5: "I've used Forest for years as a pro member, but the recent UI updates have made it almost unusable. I've gone from using Forest every day to barely opening the app, and unless the developers listen to consumer feedback and go back to the way things were, I'll be uninstalling the app. Such a shame, a great app completely ruined!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
